responsibility: Declares reusable formatting helpers for Rust AST textual rendering. The header introduces the indentation and attribute-mode enums and the utility functions used by AST `as_string` and dump code to manage indentation state, describe inner versus outer attributes, wrap text in Rust delimiters, append formatted attribute blocks, and strip surrounding quotes from string literals.
same_name_distinction: Declares the common AST formatting enums and helper functions used by dump/stringification code, while the same-stem `.cc` file contains their concrete implementations such as indentation tracking, delimiter wrapping, and attribute appending.
